subject: geopol.gulf
name: Gulf-state digital or technology cooperation instrument
milestone: No Gulf digital or telecom instrument found
position_start: None on record
position_end: Still none in the digital sector. The one Gulf engagement inside the window is energy: a 16 megawatt solar array with battery storage on Grande Comore funded by the government of the United Arab Emirates and developed by a Masdar subsidiary. The submarine cable delivered in 2016 was installed by an Emirati marine contractor, but the record the base holds does not name it
note: a searched absence in the digital sector, not an absence of Gulf money in the country

subject: geopol.india
name: Indian digital or technology cooperation instrument
status: Implemented, a 2019 framework with no project on record
milestone: Six 2019 memoranda still the standing framework, on India's own brief
position_start: Six memoranda signed at the October 2019 vice-presidential visit, including one on participation in the tele-education and tele-medicine network project
position_end: Unchanged: India's own bilateral brief of April 2026 states the six remain the standing framework, the tele-education and tele-medicine memorandum being the clearest digital commitment on it. The embassy separately records a training-programme day held in Moroni on 24 March 2026 attended by ministry secretaries-general, without naming a digital course delivered. No Indian telecom investment, submarine cable or data-centre project is on record
note: seven years of a framework with nothing on file showing what was delivered under it
